programme.title: A Wizard's Tale
programme.desc: From the writer of Ice Age: The Meltdown and with a stellar voice cast, including Ian McShane (John Wick, Coraline), Lily Collins (Mirror Mirror) and Toby Kebbell (Ben-Hur, Warcraft), A WIZARD’S TALE is an uplifting magical journey that is guaranteed to cast its spell on adults and children alike. A WIZARD’S TALE is a magical family adventure about one boy’s quest to restore happiness to the world after an evil wizard named “The Grump” casts an evil spell on a formerly happy land. Join Terry on his adventure, as he outwits a multitude of weird and wonderful creatures and finds friendship with Princess Dawn along the way. A.k.a. Here Comes the Grump

programme.title: The Little Mermaid
programme.desc: In this whimsical animated adventure, a mermaid princess makes a deal with a sea witch to transform into a human.

programme.title: A Stork's Journey
programme.desc: Richard is a sparrow. Orphaned at birth and raised by storks, he believes that he is a stork, too! But when winter comes and his adoptive flock prepare to migrate to Africa, his true identity is revealed and his family must leave him behind in the forest with the other sparrows. Determined to prove he is a stork after all, Richard ventures south on an epic adventure, accompanied by friends big and small, to unleash his true potential and be reunited with his family.

programme.title: Angel and the Badman
programme.desc: Quirt Evans, an all round bad guy, is nursed back to health and sought after by Penelope Worth, a Quaker girl. He eventually finds himself having to choose between his world and the world Penelope lives in.

programme.title: Zorro
programme.desc: In the New World, a new Spanish governor finds the province of Nueva Aragón under the iron fist of the corrupt Colonel Huerta and vows to bring justice under the guise of a masked avenger.

programme.title: Asteroid: Final Impact
programme.desc: As the Earth is on a collision course with a deadly asteroid after a small-scale meteor shower, a discredited astrophysicist and his team race against time to hack into a state-of-the-art meteor-tracking satellite. Can he save the world?

programme.title: Gorgo
programme.desc: The classic sci-fi story of a captured baby prehistoric monster put on display in London, with giant momma monster coming to the rescue!

programme.title: The People That Time Forgot
programme.desc: In 1919, a British expedition in the Antarctica region is searching for a lost American explorer and finds a hidden prehistoric world instead.

programme.title: Heartbreakers
programme.desc: Max and Page Conners are a mother-and-daughter con team. Their cunning plan? Max singles out a wealthy man and convinces him to marry her. Once married, Page seduces the unsuspecting groom whilst ensuring Max catches them in the an uncompromising position. Cue divorce proceedings and a large settlement. What could possibly go wrong, except maybe falling in love?

programme.title: Iron Men
programme.desc: Checking out the West Ham United journey as they relocate after over a century at Upton Park. Fans and behind-the-scenes moments capture this big move to their new stadium.

programme.title: The Walking Deceased
programme.desc: When a police officer wakes up in a hospital to find out he is in the middle of a zombie apocalypse, he will do anything to find his family, even sacrifice Twitter. The Walking Deceased is an hilarious spoof of The Walking Dead is about to spread. The story follows a group of survivors from all walks of the apocalypse - an idiotic Sheriff, his belligerent son, four squabbling friends, and a lonely zombie. They all leave their safe hideouts in search of the Safe Haven Ranch, a refuge untouched by the zombie virus.

programme.title: A Patch of Fog
programme.desc: A security guard catches a famous writer/television host shoplifting and blackmails him into becoming friends. He then uses that friendship and the eve of the anniversary of the publication of his most successful novel to manipulate him further.

programme.title: Father's Little Dividend
programme.desc: Shortly after coming to terms with his daughter's marriage, a father faces the prospect of becoming a grandfather.

programme.title: Mothers Of The Bride
programme.desc: Jenna is getting married, her mother is delighted until Jenna announces she wants to find her birth mother.

programme.title: Wedding Bells
programme.desc: Two people with commitment issues are asked to be best man and maid of honour at their friends' wedding. With nothing much in common, they didn't expect to find the romance of a life time.

programme.title: The Sundowners
programme.desc: In Australia's Outback during the early twentieth century, the impoverished Carmody family lives a nomadic life out of their wagon, but the mom and son want to settle, while the dad is against it.
